Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Grandchester Mystery Mansion](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72636) — After finding Zachariah, go through the red Master-locked door next to the bed. The mini nuke can then be found in a yellow container next to the steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the upper floor of [Starport Nuka](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72632)'s Star Control area, inside a display case with an Advanced-difficulty lock. You can also find [a key](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454812) to unlock the case in an office with a novice-difficulty locked door nearby.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Cola-Cars Arena](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72635) - Inside a red locker in the locker room.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a table behind Aaron Corbett in the [Nuka-Town Market](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72650).

Locations.Title: Overboss Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Worn by Overboss Colter inside [Cola-Cars Arena](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72635).  

**Prerequisite:** Defeat Overboss Colter during [Taken For A Ride](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401856)

Locations.Title: Nuka T-51f Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the [World of Refreshment](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72639).  Enter the tunnel titled "Enjoy the Ride" and follow the Nuka Quantum river back into the building until you come across the armor on your right behind a locked door.  Head through the broken wall under the Nuka Grape sign and up the stairs and into the control room.  Find the 'Systems Control Terminal' to unlock the door to the power armor.

Locations.Title: Quantum X-01 Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside the Star Control building, in the display case.  

**Prerequisite:** Install all 35 Star Cores during main quest _Star Control_

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Power armor with fusion core on a military truck

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Nuka-World Power Plant](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72659) - behind a security door in the basement. Hack the Advanced terminal next to it to gain access.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a shack with an Expert Level Door.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the locked (novice) building beneath the large power antenna. Hack the terminal (advanced) to gain access to the armor.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the garage of Morton Residence. You can teleport inside by looking at the power armor station through the window and using it - or enter the intended way, through a [Drainpipe](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461563) at the base of a stone wall to the west.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the end of the bridge on top of Bradberton Overpass. Be quick, as a Gunner can enter the frame before you reach it.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Worn by a Gunner Leader on the [Bradberton Overpass](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72640). Destroy or steal the fusion core to take the frame, or kill its wearer to take the pieces.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cide Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [Cappy's Cafe](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454828), on the counter in the cafe's kitchen.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Punch Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Grandchester Mystery Mansion](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72636) — At the end of the tour in the room with Zachariah, on top of a dresser opposite the exit door.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cooler Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Head south from the Star Control under the Star Market sign.  Immediately after passing under the sign, turn left and find the recipe on a yellow magazine rack

Locations.Title: Nuka-Void Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Starlight Interstellar Theater](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72634)— In the main theater room, on a counter near the theater's controls.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Ray Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [RobCo Battlezone](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72631) — Underneath the seating area in the battlezone, in the gift shop. The recipe is on yellow shelves with Nuka-Cola bottles, opposite the cash registers.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Sunrise Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Dry Rock Gulch Theater](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72643) — Inside the brick building with a red awning and Nuka-Cola Cherry sign. On a metal table near Nuka-Cola theme park statues.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Xtreme Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Dry Rock Gulch Theater](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72643) — Enter the theater and turn right. Walk up the outdoor stands and ladder until you reach the sniper nest on the neighboring building. On a small metal table next to the skeleton.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Bombdrop Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Mad Mulligan's Minecart Coaster](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72626), Exterior — Between the building and Bandit Roundup carnival game, on top of a Nuka-World food cart.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Rush Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Safari Adventure](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72625), Welcome Center (Interior) — On the desk next to the computer, in the main lobby below the entrance.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Hearty Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Safari Adventure](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72625), Exterior — From the park's entrance, turn left. Follow the path and, just before the ship with the shamrock, turn left down the alley.  At the end of the alley, make another left to find a shack against the brick outer wall. The recipe is inside the shack, on a shelf.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Lixir Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Fun House](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72627), Interior — After solving all the Fun House puzzles and illusions, you have the option to unchain the shortcut to the entrance or open a door to the maintenance hallways. Go down the maintenance hallways until you reach Oswald's control room. On top of the red terminal desk.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Berry Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [King Cola's Castle](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72628), Interior — Walk onto the stage to enter the backstage area. Go through the archway straight back and open the double-doors on the right to the women's dressing room. On the middle vanity desk.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Power Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Nuka-World Power Plant](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72659) — just before the ladder that leads to the roof, you'll reach a room on the catwalk with a pool table and two skeletons sitting at desks. 

The recipe is on a desk next to the skeleton in the corner.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Frutti Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the [Hubologist's Camp](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72656), on booth table within the diner.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Love Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Speak to Evan, sitting at the top of [Evan's Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72655), and agree to take some supplies when he offers them.

Locations.Title: Project Cobalt Schematics
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the _Secure Beverageer Lab_ inside the [World of Refreshment](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72639).  After entering the Lab, take the elevator down and find the schematics in the _Test Room_

**Prerequisite:** Turn the main power back on in the park during main quest _Power Play_

**Effect:** You can now build Quantum Grenades and [Thirst Zapper](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=76418) modifications.

Locations.Title: Predator Grenade Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unique grenade that attracts predators. Given to you by Mason at the start of the [Home Sweet Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401869) quest.

Locations.Title: Persuasion Grenade Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unique grenade that makes it easier to scare settlers out of their settlements. Given to you by Lizzie Wyath at the start of the [Home Sweet Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401869) quest.

Locations.Title: Fury Grenade Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unique grenade that turns enemies against one another. Given to you by Dixie at the start of the [Home Sweet Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401869) quest.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Nuke Schematics
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Behind the locked safe door in John-Caleb Bradberton's office.

**Prerequisite:** Complete side quest [Cappy in a Haystack](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401873) siding with Bradberton at the end and killing him (alternatively you can side with Sierra to get her reward, then turn off the power to kill Bradberton afterwards to get all rewards - Sierra will turn hostile).

Locations.Title: Smooth Operator Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Recipe for a chem that grants Charisma +3 and better prices when bartering for 4 minutes. Given to you by Lizzie Wyath at the start of the [Home Sweet Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401869) quest.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Girl Rocketsuit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Nuka-Galaxy](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72630) — Loot the Nuka-Girl animatronic sitting on a rocket near the ride's exit.

Locations.Title: Oswald's Tophat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On top of the roof of [King Cola's Castle](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72628), where it's either given to you by Oswald the Outrageous after showing him [Rachel's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=437237) or taken from his corpse.

**Effect:** 
- +1 Perception
- +1 Charisma
- Increases the wearer's movement speed by 10%.

Locations.Title: Magician's Tuxedo
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On the roof of [King Cola's Castle](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72628), where it can only be obtained by killing Oswald the Outrageous.

**Effect:**
- +1 Charisma
- +1 Endurance
- Reduces damage from humans by 15%

Locations.Title: Nuka World Jumpsuit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside John-Caleb Bradberton's office - given to you by Sierra.

**Prerequisite:** Complete side quest [Cappy in a Haystack](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401873) siding with Sierra by keeping Bradberton alive. You can side with Sierra to get her reward, then turn off the power to kill Bradberton and get the [Nuka-Nuke Launcher [Unique Fat Man]](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=76335) - but Sierra will turn hostile.

**Effect:**
- Intelligence +1
- Perception +1

Locations.Title: Splattercannon [7.62]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Purchased from the merchant Aaron Corbett in the [Nuka-Town Market](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72650)

**Effect:** +15% Damage after each consecutive hit on the same target

Locations.Title: Nuka-Nuke Launcher [Unique Fat Man]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Behind the locked safe door in John-Caleb Bradberton's office.

**Prerequisite:** Complete side quest [Cappy in a Haystack](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401873) siding with Bradberton at the end and killing him (alternatively you can side with Sierra to get her reward, then turn off the power to kill Bradberton afterwards to get all rewards - Sierra will turn hostile).

**Effect:** Fires Nuka-nukes and deals 50% more damage than a standard Fat Man

Locations.Title: The Problem Solver [7.62]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Obtained from Mason in [Bradberton Amphitheater](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72652) during main quest [An Ambitious Plan](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401867)

**Prerequisite:** It is advised to save before meeting Mason for the first time as you'll only get one chance for this weapon.  Take an aggressive dialogue route by choosing dialogue options on the right-hand side, and passing the Charisma checks for the duration of the conversation.  After passing the final dialogue option 'Do as your told', you'll be rewarded with the weapon

**Effect:** +15% Damage after each consecutive hit on the same target

Locations.Title: Acid Soaker [Acid]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Nuka-Cade](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=148953) - has a chance of appearing in the Nuka-Cade Prize Terminal's Level 5 prizes, where it can be purchased for 6250 tickets.

**Effect:** Inflicts ongoing acid damage and temporarily reduces damage resistance.

Locations.Title: Thirst Zapper [Water, Nuka Ammo]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the _Secure Beverageer Lab_ inside the [World of Refreshment](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72639).  After entering the Lab, take the elevator down and find the gun in the _Test Room_

**Prerequisite:** Turn the main power back on in the park during main quest [Power Play](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401870)

**Note:** Can be picked up elsewhere earlier in the game, but is pretty useless until you get the [Project Cobalt Schematics](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=76417) and mod it, at which point it becomes extremely powerful.

**Effect:** Each Nuka mod increases damage and projectiles deal AoE damage.  Effects are amplified with the rarity of the refreshment used.  Additionally, projectiles track targets in VATS.

Locations.Title: Aeternus [Gatling Laser]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Defeat the Rogue Knight challenger in [Cola-Cars Arena](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72635)

**Prerequisite:** Obtained at the end of the [Amoral Combat](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401872) side quest.  Note that this quest is repeatable with different enemies to challenge, the Rogue Knight being one of them.

**Effect:** Unlimited Mag Size.

Locations.Title: Hub's Alien Blaster
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unique Energy Weapon. Reward for completing [Trip to the Stars](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401886).

Locations.Title: Thirst Zapper [Water]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Cola-Cars Arena](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72635) - Inside a locker in the locker room, close to the ground.

**Note:** Used to kill Colter during [Taken For A Ride](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401856), but otherwise quite useless until you get the [Project Cobalt Schematics](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=76417) and mod it to use different (and _way_ more powerful) types of ammo.

Locations.Title: Cito's Shiny Slugger
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Reward for helping Cito defeat a Gatorclaw when entering the [Safari Adventure](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72625) area.

Locations.Title: Sword of Wonders
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** On top of the roof of [King Cola's Castle](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72628)

**Prerequisite:** Found at the end of [A Magical Kingdom](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401876), where it's either given to you by Oswald the Outrageous after showing him [Rachel's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=437237) or taken from his corpse.

**Effect:** Ignores 30% damage and energy resistance

Locations.Title: Commie Whacker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In the Nuka-Cade, lying on the ground in front of the 'Red Menace' arcade game.

Locations.Title: Throatslicer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Purchased from Katelyn Alden the Brahmin merchant in [Nuka-Town Market](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-4/maps/nuka-world?locationIds=72650)

**Effect:** +25 Bleed Damage over 5 seconds.

Locations.Title: Taken For A Ride
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous:** All Aboard

**Quest Giver:** Porter Gage & RedEye

_A man named Porter Gage spoke to me over the Nuka-Express speaker system. He told me I was heading into a death trap, but he has an offer for me should I survive._

**Rewards:**
- 500+ XP
- [Overboss Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=76420) (Full Set)
- Raider Rank: Overboss

**Next:** [An Ambitious Plan](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401867)

Locations.Title: An Ambitious Plan
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous:** [Taken For A Ride](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401856)

**Quest Giver:** Porter Gage

_Gage has explained that in order to take over all of Nuka-World, I need to get the three rival gangs to support me. The Disciples, The Operators, and the Pack all need to be convinced that I can lead them as Overboss._

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP
- Companion: [Porter Gage](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=351108)

**Next:** [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868)

Locations.Title: The Grand Tour
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous:** [An Ambitious Plan](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401867)

**Quest Giver:** Porter Gage

_To expand the territory for my gangs, I need to secure all of the parks beyond the walls of Nuka-Town U.S.A. and then choose which gangs will occupy the areas permanently._

**Note:** It is not possible to evenly assign parks (5 parks, 3 gangs), so inevitably one gang will be left short. This has repercussions later in [Power Play](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401870), so choose wisely!

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP

**Next:** [Home Sweet Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401869)

Locations.Title: Home Sweet Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous:** [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868)

**Quest Giver:** Porter Gage

_Gage seems to think we should start expanding into the Commonwealth. He suggested I talk to a man named Shank in the Nuka-Town market._

**Rewards:**
- 500+ XP

**Next:** [Power Play](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401870)

Locations.Title: Power Play
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**END OF NUKA-WORLD (DLC) QUESTLINE**

**Previous:** [Home Sweet Home](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401869)

**Quest Giver:** Shank

_Now that I've established a proper foothold in the Commonwealth, I should return to Shank to discuss our next move._

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP
- 2 x Perks awarded based on which two gangs remained loyal:
   - Ace Operator (Operators)
   - Chosen Disciple (Disciples)
   - Pack Alpha (The Pack)

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

[Mad Mulligan's Minecart Coaster](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72626) — In the chained gift shop by the ride's entrance. Travel through the ride to get on the other side of the chained door.

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

Near the ride's exit, at the top of the stairs behind the [Nuka-Girl Rocketsuit](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401894)-wearing mannequin.

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

Follow the rail-lined walkway through the tour until you reach the exit vault door. As you exit, turn left to find the medallion dispenser in the corner.

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

[World of Refreshment](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72639), Exterior — In the queue lines outside the attraction.

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

[Cappy's Treehouse](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72624) — Navigate to the center of the maze, then take the elevator up to the treehouse. On the lower treehouse floor, in an alcove near the Nuka-Cola mascot statue.

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

At the base of the Ferris Wheel, against the fence.

Locations.Title: Park Medallion
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [Precious Medals](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401879)

At the ride entrance to Nuka-Racers, near the track start.

Locations.Title: Amoral Combat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868), leave then return to [Nuka-Town USA](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72651)

**Quest Giver:** None (Automatically Added)

_Gang members have informed the Overboss that a challenger has appeared in the Gauntlet. Will you accept the fight invitation?_

**Rewards:**
- 75+ XP
- [Aeternus](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=76423) (after killing the sixth challenger, 'Rogue Knight')

Locations.Title: Cappy in a Haystack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Sierra Petrovita

_A Nuka-Cola Super Fan is on the hunt for "Hidden Cappy" signs throughout Nuka World. Will you help her?_

Note: It's recommended to complete this in tandem with [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868) because the list of objective locations are nearly the same.

**Hidden Cappy Locations:**
- [Nuka-Town USA](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=389670)
- [Safari Adventure: Cappy's Treehouse](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401900)
- [Safari Adventure: Primate House](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454783)
- [Dry Rock Gulch: Graveyard](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=405135)
- [Dry Rock Gulch: Mad Mulligan's Mine](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454791)
- [Galactic Zone: Star Control](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454787)
- [Galactic Zone: RobCo Battlezone](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454790)
- [Kiddie Kingdom: Fun House](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454782)
- [Kiddie Kingdom: King Cola's Castle](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454781)
- [World of Refreshment](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454779)

**Rewards:**
-  XP
- Side with J.C. Bradberton:
    - 500 Caps + [Nuka-Nuke Launcher](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=76335)
- Side with Sierra Petrovita:
    - [Nuka World Jumpsuit](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=538639)

Locations.Title: High Noon at The Gulch
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Enter [Dry Rock Gulch](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72644) (Automatically Added)

_Dry Rock Gulch is infested with Bloodworms. The Bloodworms are nesting inside of Mad Mulligan's Mine. The door is locked, and the only key is in a safe. I need to get the combination from the other Protectron cowboys._

Note: A large portion of this quest can be bypassed by convincing the Protectrons to hand over the keys. Requires high Charisma or Robotics Expert perk.

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP
- 200 Caps
- Cowboy Hat
- Western Outfit
- Western Revolver
- [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868): Control of Dry Rock Gulch

Locations.Title: A Magical Kingdom
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Enter [Kiddie Kingdom](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72641) (Automatically Added)

_Kiddie Kingdom is covered in radioactive mist and a strange voice has taunted me over the Park Announcement system. I should look for the source of the voice._

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP
- Oswald's Tophat
- Sword of Wonders
- [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868): Control of Kiddie Kingdom

Locations.Title: Open Season
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Givers:**
- Mackenzie Bridgeman, Doctor in [Nuka-Town Market](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72650)
- Preston Garvey, given as a Minutemen settlement defense quest 

_McKenzie Bridgeman suggested that I should wipe out the Raiders at Nuka-World. I will consider her proposal._

Note: This side quest serves as an alternate ending to the Nuka-World DLC quest line. Completing it makes all raiders hostile and essentially wipes Nuka-World empty; only non-raider traders and quests will be available. You can still power up Nuka-World afterwards. Plus, it makes Preston Garvey _very_ happy!

**Rewards:**
- 600 XP
- Liberated Traders

Locations.Title: Precious Medals
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** N.I.R.A. (Nuka-Cola Robot)

_Collect a commemorative Park Medallion from every major Nuka-World park and receive a special reward!_

Note: It's recommended to complete this in tandem with [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868) because the list of objective locations are nearly the same.

Park Medallions:
- [Dry Rock Gulch: Mad Mulligan's Minecart Coaster](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401875)
- [Galactic Zone: Nuka-Galaxy ](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401895)
- [Galactic Zone: Vault-Tec Among the Stars](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401896)
- [Kiddie Kingdom: Ferris Wheel](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=402221)
- [Kiddie Kingdom: Nuka-Racers](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=402222)
- [Safari Adventure: Cappy's Treehouse](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401899)

Locations.Title: Safari Adventure
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Cito

_I met a man named Cito in the Safari Adventure area of Nuka-World. He asked me to help him take care of the Gatorclaw infestation in the area._

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP
- [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868): Control of Safari Adventure
- [Cito's Shiny Slugger](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=76326)

Locations.Title: Star Control
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Enter [Galactic Zone](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72648) (Automatically Added)

_Just outside the Galactic Zone, I found the remains of a battle between a group of traders and some robots. One of the traders was carrying a holotape that might explain what happened here._

Tip: There are 35 total Star Cores in Nuka-World, but you only need 20 Star Cores to complete the quest. 

At 5, 10, and 15 Star Cores found, new terminal options to make Galactic Zone easer to explore. At 20 Star Cores, all robots in Galactic Zone become friendly. If you find all 35 Star Cores, the center display will open and you can loot the Quantum X-01 Power Armor..

**Rewards:**
- 400+ XP
- [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868): Control of Galactic Zone
- Automatron DLC: Unlocks all Nuka-World robot mods

Locations.Title: Trip to the Stars
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Dara Hubell, Leader of [Hubologist's Camp](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72656)

_Met a strange man who invited me to join Hubology._

**Rewards:**
- 450+ XP
- 200-350 Caps
- [Hub's Alien Blaster](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401887)

Locations.Title: A World of Refreshment
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Enter [World of Refreshment](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72639) (Automatically Added)

_World of Refreshment is overrun with rogue robots and Nukalurks. Clear out the interior and exterior to take control of the bottling plant._

**Rewards:**
- 350+ XP
- [The Grand Tour](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401868): Control of Nuka-Cola Bottling Plant

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location near the end of the street leading up to the [Fizztop Grille](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72646).

Locations.Title: Nuka Galaxy Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Defended by cave crickets. Three dead settlers. Some exotic nuka cola bottles are stored.

Locations.Title: Raiders Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Look for a wind turbine power tower.

Locations.Title: Dunmore's Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A safe with a master-difficulty lock can be found directly west of [Dunmore Homestead](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72657). Brett Dunmore will give you the key if you complete [Open Season](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401877).

Search the area around the safe to find a shovel, caps stash, weapon, and some ammo.

Locations.Title: Cappy's Cafe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location immediately to your left as you go through a red door at the southern end of the street.

Locations.Title: Large Building
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A group of raiders can be found fighting super mutants or other enemies here.

Loot in the area includes junk, miscellaneous containers, and fever blossom plants.

Locations.Title: Radioactive Truck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A truck filled with radioactive barrels can be found in a toxic puddle here.

In the back of the truck, you can find a combat rifle and explosives box with a novice-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Mirelurk Lake
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A polluted lake can be found here, home to a group of Mirelurks and their queen. At the southern edge of the lake, you can find a skeleton alongside a minigun, some ammo, and a steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Super Mutant Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A lone super mutant and his pet hound can be found living here.

Search the shack to find a first aid kit, junk, weapons workbench, bobby pin box, and some carrots.

Locations.Title: Deathclaw Nest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A deathclaw has created a nest beneath the rocky overhang here.

A steamer trunk can be found among the skeletons.

Locations.Title: Small Farm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A small house can be found here. Loot consists of a few crops and junk items.

Locations.Title: Small Farm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked house and garage can be found here. Loot consists of junk items, crops, miscellaneous containers, and a bottle of bourbon.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Town Backstage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked interior accessed through red doors in the [Bradberton Amphitheater](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72652).

Locations.Title: Clark's Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A uniquely-named footlocker, found underneath the bridge. Can only be unlocked with [Clark's Stash Key](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461540)

Locations.Title: Dry Rock Gulch - Employee Access Door
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the exterior wall. Only accessible after main power is returned at the end of [Power Play](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401870), and partially hidden behind a hedge.

Locations.Title: Behemoth Cave
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A Super Mutant Behemoth lurks in the small ravine here.

Locations.Title: Safari Adventure Welcome Center
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location opposite the entrance to the [Safari Adventure](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72625) zone. Grab [Dr. Hein's Passcode](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461547) to gain access to the basement.

Locations.Title: Ruined Building
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Home to a group of Gunners, and often attacked by the local raider gangs.

Search it to find a cooking station, armor workbench, junk, and food.

Locations.Title: Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A reasonably sized camp can be found here.

Search it to find a bed, ammo box, junk, food, chemistry station, crops, and a chem cooler with a novice-difficulty lock. In the corner behind a bed, you'll also find a safe with a Master-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Drainpipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Leads to [Morton Residence](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72618), giving you access to the power armor inside.

Locations.Title: Ruins
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Master-locked safe and some junk

Locations.Title: Bear cave back entrance
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Back entrance of the bear cave

Locations.Title: Nuka-World Access Tunnels (The Gauntlet)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Entered during [Taken For A Ride](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401856). Good luck!

Locations.Title: Crashed Vertibird
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Has a military trunk and a wooden crate

Locations.Title: Mad Mulligan's Minecart Coaster
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Entered during the [High Noon at the Gulch](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401874) quest after getting your hands on [Mad Mulligan's Mine Key](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461542).

Locations.Title: Dry Rock Gulch Employee Area
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Entered via [Dry Rock Gulch - Employee Access Door](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461541)

Locations.Title: Porter Gage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [An Ambitious Plan](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401867) (Nuka World Quest)

**Companion Quest:** None

**Romanceable?** Yes

**Affinity Interests:**
- Mean, selfish, violent behavior
- Modify weapons
- Commit murder
- Lockpick
- Cap reward negotiation
- Steal items
- Refuse settlement quest

**Companion Perk:** Lessons in Blood — +5% more XP per kill and +10 Damage Resistance

Locations.Title: Grandchester Master Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Grandchester Mystery Mansion](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72636) — Looted from Zachariah, found in a room at the end of the tour.

Locations.Title: RobCo Battlezone Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Four are inside the [RobCo Battlezone](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72631). They can be found:
- On a countertop in the gift shop.
- On a table opposite a door leading to the basement
- In the Employees Only room to your left as you enter the main area
- In the basement beneath the arena, on the cabinet opposite a Sentry Bot

Locations.Title: Nuka-Galaxy Employee Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Two are inside [Nuka-Galaxy](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72630).

One is on top of a console opposite the [Nuka-Girl Rocketsuit](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401894)-wearing mannequin near the ride's exit, and the other is on top of a console in the nearby employees-only area that the key unlocks.

Locations.Title: Galactic Zone Manager's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On the upper floor of Star Control, on a desk in the office with a novice-difficulty locked door.

Used to unlock a display case holding a [Star Core](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454789) nearby.

Locations.Title: Starlight Theater Pantry Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Starlight Interstellar Theater](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72634) - On a countertop in the kitchens found in the building's south-eastern corner.

Unlocks the nearby pantry that houses a [Star Core](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454815).

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Employee Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Vault Tec: Among the Stars](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72633) - Multiple can be found throughout the area. Locations include:
- On a filing cabinet to your left immediately after entering (near the tour's entrance)
- On the shelves of a desk opposite the elevators on the lower floor (near the tour's exit)
- On top of a desk on the lower floor (near the tour's exit)

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Observation Lab Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Vault Tec: Among the Stars](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72633) - Follow the tour until you reach a vault. Jump over the railings into the atrium, follow a corridor, and you'll find the key in a locker.

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Control Room Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Vault Tec: Among the Stars](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72633) - Follow the tour until you reach a vault's 'residential' area. Pick through an Expert-difficulty lock in the corner (or use the [Vault-Tec Observation Lab Key](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=454823)) to find the key on a desk.

Locations.Title: Grandchester Guest Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of the 'Ticket Taker', a Protectron found dead outside the [Grandchester Mystery Mansion](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72636).

Unlocks the mansion's front door.

Locations.Title: Clark's Stash Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside Clark's Toolbox, found in a closed restroom stall and secured with an advanced-difficulty lock. Used to unlock [Clark's Stash](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461539)

Locations.Title: Mad Mulligan's Mine Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a safe opened during [High Noon at The Gulch](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401874). Play along with the robots' antics, or just kill them and loot their parts of the code to gain access.

Used to enter [Mad Mulligan's Minecart Coaster](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72626).

Locations.Title: AFAD Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a duffle bag on top of the trailer it unlocks.

Locations.Title: Dr. Hein's Passcode
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a tool case in the trailer. Pick through the expert-difficulty lock, or use the [AFAD Key](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461546) to reach it.

Unlocks an Employees Only terminal blocking your access to the basement in the [Safari Adventure Welcome Center](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=461548).

Locations.Title: Casey's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On top of a cabinet in a small room on the roof of the bottling plant.

Locations.Title: Dry Rock Gulch Theater Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a red toolbox at the bottom of the ramp on the platform where you find the [Nuka-Xtreme Recipe](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=76147).

Locations.Title: Dark Souls Easter Egg
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the open house, a bonfire can be kindled to receive stimpaks. This is a reference to the Dark Souls series, where bonfires with swords sticking out of them act as checkpoints that restore your health.

Locations.Title: Nuka-World Red Rocket Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The only settlement in Nuka-World. 

Perfect for a large farm - ranked 4th in maximum horizontal build area, and 1st in maximum build height, standing at 20 floors in height. Supply lines can be linked from this workshop to Commonwealth settlements. 

Siding with the Nuka-World raiders before interacting with this workshop will turn it into a raider outpost, but you can avoid this by completing [Open Season](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=401877) or not siding with the raiders.
